top_stories.title: Cisco Zero-Day Highlights API Endpoint Authentication Issues
top_stories.summary: A maximum-severity authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-76460) has been discovered in Cisco's Identity Services Engine (ISE), receiving a CVSS score of 10 out of 10. The zero-day flaw affects API endpoint authentication within Cisco's ISE platform, a widely deployed network access control and identity management solution.

top_stories.title: Cisco Warns of New Zero-Day ISE Auth Bypass (CVSS 10.0) Exploited in Active Attacks
top_stories.summary: Cisco has disclosed a maximum-severity (CVSS 10.0) zero-day authentication bypass vulnerability in its Identity Services Engine (ISE), tracked as CVE-2026-76460, which is currently under active exploitation. The flaw exists in an API endpoint with insufficient authentication controls, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass authentication entirely.

top_stories.title: The Pillar Cracks Three Ways: Azure Identity Infrastructure Takes Three Max-Severity Hits in One Patch Tuesday
top_stories.summary: Microsoft's September 2026 Patch Tuesday addressed three maximum-severity vulnerabilities in Azure's identity infrastructure, part of a record-breaking 964 CVE update cycle. All three flaws targeted the Azure identity stack directly, representing a significant cluster of critical weaknesses in Microsoft's cloud identity services.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Entra Agent ID Expands with MCP Firewall, Adding Network-Level Control to Agent Governance
top_stories.summary: Microsoft is expanding its Entra Agent ID governance framework with the introduction of an MCP Firewall, adding network-level control to AI agent management. The new capability provides security teams with additional enforcement mechanisms to govern AI agents operating in enterprise production environments within the Microsoft Entra ecosystem.

top_stories.title: Keeper Security and SailPoint Partner to Automate Privileged Access Governance
top_stories.summary: Keeper Security and SailPoint have announced a partnership to integrate SailPoint's Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platform with Keeper's Identity Security Platform. The integration aims to automate privileged access governance across all identities using a zero-trust approach.

news.title: Claude Opus 5 Helped Researchers Take Over OpenAI Staff Accounts via Chained Flaws
news.summary: Security researchers at Hacktron used Claude Opus 5 to chain two vulnerabilities—a bug in OpenAI's public help forum software and a weakness in OpenAI's login system—to take over ChatGPT and Codex accounts of OpenAI employees and access an internal code repository. The attack exploited flaws in OpenAI's authentication and account management infrastructure, demonstrating account takeover risks in login systems.

news.title: Identity Visibility in 2026: The Foundation of Identity Security
news.summary: An article explains the concept of identity visibility as a foundation for identity security in IAM, referencing credential-based breaches from Verizon's Data Breach Investigations Report. The piece covers what identity visibility means in IAM contexts and how cloud and multicloud environments create complications for managing it.

news.title: SolarWinds Patches ARM Hard-Coded Key Flaw Enabling Unauthenticated RCE
news.summary: SolarWinds has patched a high-severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-28326, CVSS 8.8) in its Access Rights Manager (ARM) product that allowed unauthenticated remote code execution via a hard-coded key. The flaw affects all versions of Access Rights Manager 2026.2 and prior.

news.title: CrowdSec Says TanStack npm Attack Led to Copy of 170 Private GitHub Repositories
news.summary: CrowdSec disclosed that an attacker copied approximately 170 of its private GitHub repositories on May 22 by exploiting the GitHub account of a recently departed employee whose access had not been revoked. The credentials were stolen via a supply chain attack on TanStack npm packages, and the incident highlights a failure in offboarding and access lifecycle management.

news.title: MFA Won't Save You From OAuth Consent Abuse
news.summary: The article argues that MFA alone is insufficient to protect against OAuth consent abuse attacks, where attackers trick users into granting malicious applications access to their accounts. The piece covers OAuth governance controls including least-privilege scopes, consent monitoring, and token revocation as necessary complementary measures.

news.title: Fake LastPass Authenticator GitHub repos push new Rapuncel infostealer
news.summary: A malware campaign is using SEO-optimized GitHub repositories impersonating LastPass Authenticator to distribute a previously undocumented infostealer called Rapuncel. The campaign targets users searching for legitimate authentication software by mimicking well-known security vendors on GitHub.

news.title: Secure enterprise sharing with access reviews for Microsoft 365
news.summary: Tenfold Software has published guidance on managing persistent file access in Microsoft 365 through centralized access governance and owner-driven access reviews. The piece outlines how organizations can gain visibility into who retains access to sensitive data and remove unnecessary permissions after their original purpose has ended.

news.title: Hardcoded MCP credentials found in public GitHub files
news.summary: Hush Security research found that 12% of credential slots in approximately 82,000 publicly accessible MCP configuration files on GitHub contained hardcoded credential literals, including API keys and access tokens used by AI coding tools. The findings are documented in "The State of MCP Configuration: The Identity Security Gaps" report, highlighting credential exposure risks in AI tool configurations.

news.title: 98% of fraudulent hires have company credentials by the time they’re caught
news.summary: HYPR's State of HR Identity Fraud Detection report found that 98% of fraudulent hires already possess company credentials by the time they are identified. The report highlights a 90-day hiring-to-onboarding gap as a critical vulnerability in enterprise identity security, where adversaries obtain legitimate credentials through the hiring process rather than network breaches.

news.title: Microsoft Patches CVSS 10.0 Azure AI Foundry Flaw Enabling Unauthorized Privilege Escalation
news.summary: Microsoft patched a maximum-severity (CVSS 10.0) vulnerability in Azure AI Foundry, tracked as CVE-2026-85889, that allowed unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network. The flaw stemmed from missing authentication for a critical function, and Microsoft states no customer action is required as the fix has been applied.

news.title: SailPoint’s (SAIL) Falcon Next-Gen SIEM Arrangement Fits Its Broader Identity Security Push
news.summary: SailPoint expanded its strategic alliance with CrowdStrike, integrating with CrowdStrike's Falcon Next-Gen SIEM platform as part of its broader identity security push. The partnership connects SailPoint's identity governance capabilities with CrowdStrike's security operations platform.

news.title: Jim Cramer Says AI Could Make Okta’s Security Software More Essential
news.summary: Jim Cramer commented on Okta during a Mad Money episode, stating that AI is making Okta's identity security software more essential rather than obsolete. The segment is a brief media mention of Okta without any new product, financial, or strategic information about the company.

news.title: Why Shares of Okta Stock Shot Up 10% This Week
news.summary: Okta's stock rose 10% this week, driven by positive market momentum in cybersecurity stocks and solid earnings results. The article covers the financial performance of the identity and authentication platform vendor Okta.

news.title: jumpserver v5.0.0
news.summary: JumpServer has released version 5.0.0 of its open-source Privileged Access Management platform. The platform provides secure access management for SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, Database, and RemoteApp endpoints via a web browser for DevOps and IT teams.

news.title: keycloak v26.7.4
news.summary: Keycloak has released version 26.7.4 of its open source identity and access management platform. The release continues Keycloak's support for modern applications and services requiring identity and access management capabilities.

news.title: vault v2.1.1
news.summary: Vault version 2.1.1 has been released as a tool supporting secrets management, encryption as a service, and privileged access management. No specific details about new features, changes, or fixes in this release are provided in the description.

news.title: Implementing defense-in-depth authorization for MCP tools on Amazon Quick
news.summary: This article details a technical implementation for applying defense-in-depth authorization to Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools using Microsoft Entra ID group and claims-based JWTs routed through an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway interceptor. The walkthrough covers per-user, per-tool access controls, combining Entra ID identity claims with AI agent infrastructure as a security layer.

news.title: Amplifier Extends Workforce Security to the AI Agents Employees Build and Use
news.summary: Amplifier Security launched Agent Intent & Posture Management, a capability that connects discovered AI agents to their employee owners and documents each agent's stated purpose for risk remediation. The product extends workforce security to AI agents built or used by employees, addressing identity and access governance concerns around non-human identities.

news.title: Druva expands identity resilience with ransomware detection
news.summary: Druva has announced expanded capabilities for its Identity Resilience product alongside a new Ransomware Detection feature powered by a proprietary AI threat pipeline called Dru MetaGraph. The new offerings use behavioral intelligence to detect identity-related threats, positioning the product at the intersection of data protection and identity security.

news.title: Okta CEO Todd McKinnon goes one-on-one with Jim Cramer
news.summary: Okta CEO Todd McKinnon appeared on CNBC's Mad Money with Jim Cramer to discuss AI agents, quarterly results, and the company's future. The conversation covered Okta's business performance and strategic direction around AI and identity.

news.title: EU Cyber Resilience Act to Enforce New Reporting Requirements
news.summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act begins enforcing a 24-hour mandatory reporting requirement for serious product security incidents. European organizations must notify EU authorities within this window upon discovering qualifying incidents, introducing a significant new compliance obligation.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch update addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software products. AI is being credited for accelerating vulnerability discovery, though security experts note organizations are struggling to keep up with the volume of patches to test and deploy.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian drivers licenses, with evidence pointing to a breach of a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official inquiry into the source of the leaked images.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake's cloud data storage platform. The case involved theft of data including over 100 million AT&T customer call and text records.
